Source: http://www.marijuananews.com

Posted October 13, 2000
Special to MarijuanaNews:

For several days this week, the NORML office has been swamped with media calls about a new NIDA study that purports to prove that marijuana is addictive.
See
Is marijuana addictive?
and links

The story is embargoed until Sunday night, the reporters have it, but NORML is expected to comment without having seen the study. This is how prohibitionist propaganda really works. How will the media cover it?
See
Author of Ottawa Citizen Series on Prohibition Blames The Media for the Drug War. Great Journalism Is The Antidote.

NIDA, the National Institute on Drug Abuse, is in charge of subordinating science to the needs of marijuana prohibition. NIDA head Alan Leshner is addicted to prohibitionist propaganda, at least by his definition of addiction.

Watch for the story Sunday and Monday.

If you are so inclined, you might email your local media outlets and urge them to look critically at the story and not just trumpet it. Urge them to take a look at MarijuanaNews.
